grader_rule: NO imposed finding format: the grader PARSES the real hunter output (file: + line: fields per finding block; `No findings.` = zero findings). A defective patch passes iff it yields >=1 Logic finding AND EVERY finding (a) LOCALIZES to the patched file AND to a TOUCHED LINE (location path == patch path exactly AND location line in the patch's pinned valid_lines) AND (b) matches its keyword regex (several findings on the same planted defect pass). Clean patches: zero findings. Same predicate identically to both variants and all runs (unanimous, not majority); both variants agree per patch. Negative fixtures: wrong-file finding naming the right file FAILS; right-file finding outside the valid-lines range FAILS.
